page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of 94,489 GB of HDD capacity. This massive storage volume is suited for high-density data retention, though the HDD medium presents a performance tradeoff compared to modern solid-state drives in random read and write operations. The absence of dedicated GPU hardware and advanced CPU instruction sets like AVX-512 or AMX limits its utility for modern machine learning and accelerated computing tasks.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers high storage density per instance, making it a viable option for workloads requiring massive local capacity without the premium cost of SSD-based storage. Appropriate workloads include large-scale data warehousing, log archiving, cold storage repositories, and distributed file systems where sequential throughput on mechanical disks is acceptable.
